verdict.rationale: Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU and NPU silicon). Subscribing to events via registrable outbound HTTP webhooks is not a capability that kind of hardware ships, so the story is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip, or its own product surface, offering webhooks that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
